name: hiker-on-trail
prompt: A lone hiker with a backpack seen from far behind and very small in frame, walking away up a narrow forest path between dense conifers, figure anonymous and unrecognisable, ordinary overcast afternoon

name: step-off
prompt: The view from just off a forest path, looking back toward where the trail should be but seeing only identical dense spruce trunks in every direction, no path visible, disorienting sameness

name: phone-to-canopy
shot: tight · Act 3 — the climb for signal
prompt: A single hand holding a mobile phone raised up toward a narrow gap of pale sky in a dense conifer canopy, only the hand and forearm visible, no face, screen dim

name: tent-in-trees
prompt: A small one-person tent pitched on a low forested rise, seen at a distance through spruce trunks, almost swallowed by the surrounding trees, no people visible, quiet and easy to miss

name: search-line
prompt: A widely spaced line of search volunteers in high-visibility vests moving through dense forest, seen from a distance, figures small and anonymous, sweeping between the trunks

name: dog-handler
prompt: A search dog and its handler seen from behind at a distance among tall conifer trunks, both small in frame and anonymous, working through thick undergrowth

name: journal-detail
prompt: A weathered small notebook and a pen resting on damp forest floor moss and fallen needles, close detail, pages blank and rain-marked, no legible writing

name: empty-clearing
prompt: A small ordinary clearing on a forested rise with flattened undergrowth where something once stood, empty, unremarkable, surrounded by dense spruce
